# `pygeovision ai-models`

Browse the 14 models of the **legacy AI-engine registry** and manage its cached weights. This registry is separate from
the main model registry used by `models` and `GeoTrainer`; [how the registries relate](../../models/registry.md).

## When to use it

Use it to see what the native `ai` commands can load, or to clear cached checkpoints.

## What you get

`list` prints a table (name, task, architecture, pretrained mark) and a total; `info` prints one model; `cache` reports or clears the cache.

## Things to know

* A name that works here may not exist in `models list`, and the reverse. Use `models` for training, `ai-models` only for
  the native `ai` commands.

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision ai-models [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  AI model management commands (legacy AI-engine registry).

  Note: this is distinct from `pygeovision models`, which uses the newer, broader native model
  registry (pygeovision.models.registry).

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  cache  Manage AI model checkpoint cache.
  info   Show details for a specific model.
  list   List the 14 models of the legacy AI-engine registry.
```

### `pygeovision ai-models cache`

Manage AI model checkpoint cache.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--clear` | flag | off |  |  |
| `--model` | text |  |  |  |

:::{dropdown} Full help text

```text
Usage: pygeovision ai-models cache [OPTIONS]

  Manage AI model checkpoint cache.

Options:
  --clear
  --model TEXT
  --help        Show this message and exit.
```
:::

### `pygeovision ai-models info`

Show details for a specific model.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `MODEL_NAME` | text | yes |

:::{dropdown} Full help text

```text
Usage: pygeovision ai-models info [OPTIONS] MODEL_NAME

  Show details for a specific model.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```
:::

### `pygeovision ai-models list`

List the 14 models of the legacy AI-engine registry.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--task` | one of `segmentation` | `detection` | `classification` | `change_detection` | `super_resolution` |  |  |  |
| `--pretrained-only` | flag | off |  |  |

:::{dropdown} Full help text

```text
Usage: pygeovision ai-models list [OPTIONS]

  List the 14 models of the legacy AI-engine registry.

Options:
  --task [segmentation|detection|classification|change_detection|super_resolution]
  --pretrained-only

```
